verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Notion's database/property system lets teams build custom, flexible workflows (e.g. 'incredibly flexible and configurable,' 'allowed us to create a workflow that fit us,' built-in structured data for boards/task lists), which implicitly covers custom fields and status tracking, but there's no first-party documentation specifically describing configurable field/property types or status workflow customization, and one comment notes limits requiring manual maintenance when used as an issue/project tracker. Missing for 10: explicit vendor docs on custom database properties/status fields, and a hands-on account of setting up a PM workflow without hitting limitations.
